hints.text: The y-axis is the mirror, so the point moves straight left or right. Think about which coordinate must change.
Keep $y = 4$. The point is $2$ units left of the y-axis, so its image is $2$ units to the right: replace $x = -2$ with its opposite.
The opposite of $-2$ is $2$, so the reflected point is $(2, 4)$.

explanation: Reflecting across the y-axis moves the point horizontally, so the y-coordinate does not change.
The x-coordinate becomes its opposite, because the image is the same distance from the y-axis on the other side.
For the point $(-2, 4)$, the value $x = -2$ becomes $2$ and $y$ stays $4$.
So the reflected point has coordinates $(2, 4)$.
